title: [CVSS 9.1 CRITICAL] CVE-2026-125331 — HarnessRouter is a self-hosted unified API for running agent harnesses with sess…
summary: HarnessRouter is a self-hosted unified API for running agent harnesses with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling. Prior to 0.31.8, a console that is not in self-hosted mode attaches the server's internal key to requests carrying an Authorization header before validating the bearer, while the service-only PUT and GET /v1/orgs/{org}/connections/{name}, PUT /v1/orgs/{org}/policy/{backend}, and /internal/* routes trust that key and take the organization from the URL. In a multi-organization deployment, a remote caller can use a made-up bearer to rewrite another organization's provider connection to an attacker-controlled endpoint, causing later prompts to be disclosed and attacker-controlled responses to influence tasks. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.8.

title: [CVSS 8.8 HIGH] CVE-2026-126087 — Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description…
summary:
Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description (OpenJD) Sessions for Python before 0.11.0, as used in the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent before 0.33.0, on Linux might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to submit jobs to a queue to execute arbitrary code as the worker agent OS user and obtain the AWS credentials held by the worker agent via a crafted job that modifies the PATH environment variable.



To remediate this issue, users of customer-managed fleets should upgrade the Deadline Cloud worker agent to version 0.33.0 or later, which includes OpenJD Sessions 0.11.0. Service-managed fleets were remediated service-side.

title: [CVSS 8.8 HIGH] CVE-2026-102166 — Arista C-260 and C-250 access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic k…
summary: Arista C-260 and C-250 access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic keys used for firmware image verification and SSLP authentication. An attacker who is able to access these keys would be able to create modified firmware that will pass verification checks. This vulnerability is specific to the C-260 and C-250 models; other access point models enforce digitally signed upgrade images with secure boot and are not affected by this issue.

title: [CVSS 8.4 HIGH] CVE-2026-120815 — An incorrect authorization check in the MongoDB Server authorization subsystem m…
summary: An incorrect authorization check in the MongoDB Server authorization subsystem may allow an unauthenticated party with local host access to obtain administrative privileges on a database server that has authorization enabled. This may result in unintended access to stored data and credentials, unintended modification of data, and loss of availability of the server.

title: [CVSS 8.2 HIGH] CVE-2026-120977 — On affected platforms running Arista EOS with 802.1X with Dynamic Host Configura…
summary: On affected platforms running Arista EOS with 802.1X with Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) device profiling enabled, a network-adjacent attacker can send a crafted DHCP packet to force the device to record a spoofed device profile. This may potentially allow the authenticated supplicant to acquire unauthorized access to a network segment with elevated privileges.

title: [CVSS 8.1 HIGH] CVE-2026-120979 — This vulnerability affects customers using Arista Pathfinder for WAN path select…
summary: This vulnerability affects customers using Arista Pathfinder for WAN path selection with Border Gateway Protocol-Link State (BGP-LS) configured for Dynamic Path Selection (DPS). On affected platforms running Arista EOS with BGP-LS configured for DPS, an attacker who has established an authenticated BGP-LS session with the device can send a specially crafted BGP packet to cause incorrect WAN path selection and disrupt traffic forwarding.

title: 「Chrome」が今週2度目の更新 - 脆弱性83件を修正、「クリティカル」も
summary: Googleは、ブラウザ「Chrome」のセキュリティアップデートを公開した。今週に入り2度目の更新で、83件の脆弱性に対処している。

title: Ivantiの5製品が脆弱性に対応 - 2製品に「クリティカル」
summary: Ivantiは、5製品に向けてセキュリティアップデートを提供し、あわせて13件の脆弱性に対応したことを明らかにした。重要度が「クリティカル」とされる脆弱性への対処も含まれる。

title: 「Firefox 160」が公開 - 99件の脆弱性に対応
summary: Mozilla Foundationは、ウェブブラウザ「Firefox」の最新版「Firefox 160」を公開した。延長サポート版とともに複数の脆弱性を解消している。

title: MS、月例更新で脆弱性1000件超に対応 - 一部で悪用確認
summary: マイクロソフトは、「Windows」や「Office」「Azure」などをはじめ、同社製品向けに2026年11月の月例セキュリティ更新を公開した。対処した脆弱性は1000件を超えており、一部脆弱性は悪用が確認されている。

title: 米セキュリティ当局、悪用確認済み脆弱性6件に注意喚起
summary: 米当局は、「Cisco BroadWorks」「Chromium」などに確認されている脆弱性6件がサイバー攻撃に悪用されているとして注意喚起を行った。とくにBarracuda Networks製品の脆弱性に関しては、早急に対応するよう求めている。

title: SAPが月例セキュリティ更新 - 「クリティカル」9件
summary: SAPは、2026年11月の月例セキュリティ更新を公開した。「SAP NetWeaver」「SAP Web Dispatcher」など、深刻な脆弱性に対応したという。

title: Apple、macOSの脆弱性8件を修正 - 「iMessage」覗き見などに対応
summary: Appleは、「macOS」のセキュリティアップデートを公開した。脆弱性8件に対処している。

title: ネット印刷サービス「ラクスル」で侵害 - 個人情報や印刷データが流出か
summary: ネット印刷サービス「ラクスル」がサイバー攻撃を受けたことがわかった。個人情報や入稿した印刷データなどが流出した可能性があるという。

title: 自治会長の住所を誤記載、別人宛に発送 - 東京都
summary: 東京都は、東京都住宅供給公社が発送した通知の一部において、宛名の住所が誤っていたことを明らかにした。
